versions.note:
From the walmart Atlas export, with what Pro adds.
Added: the shipping ZIP ({zip}) set before reading, checked on every page (the dialog's selectors are not on the saved page: test them live)
Added: the page's data (__NEXT_DATA__) read first for the title, SKU, brand, UPC, model, price, was price, rating, reviews and description
Added: the identity check: SKU against the id in the /ip/ URL
Added: page rules: a sign-in redirect, robot-check wording
Added: checks: SKU and UPC are numbers, prices in US dollars, rating 0–5, review count
Added: PRODUCT_TITLE and SKU required
Not carried over: Elements SEARCH_BOX, SEARCH_BUTTON, URL_SKU: page actions and search results are not part of a page recipe; left out.
